result.summary: PAS transfer MSG00802 (ENC-T1 to WARD-B, 08:20:00Z) failed with a 503 (ward_unavailable). There is no receipt (404). The receiver is at v2, WARD-C, epoch 31, set by BEDMGR transfer MSG00803 at the same event time, 08:20:00Z. The route supports conditional writes, receipts and dry runs, but the guard would not protect anything here: a resend conditional on v2 would apply and move the patient from WARD-C to WARD-B. That would overwrite the bed manager's placement. Under DEP-2.2/2.3 it would also free and occupy beds on the bed board, send pharmacy to a different ward and create a porter task. Doing nothing leaves WARD-C in place, which is correct only if BEDMGR is authoritative. A reconcile is not supported because no receipt shows the PAS movement in effect. Neither event is later, so supersession is undecided (E7). Only the receipt and history can be checked afterwards; the bed board, pharmacy, porters and EPR cannot be seen from here. Escalate so a person can decide which source is authoritative.
